newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR STARTS WEDNESDAY FIRMER ON UNITS.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR STARTS WEDNESDAY FIRMER ON UNITS.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar was quoted firmer against major currencies in Wednesday's midmorning interbank trade, dealers said.
"The market is pretty quiet and fairly liquid at the moment, probably a residue of the central bank's intervention on Monday and Tuesday," one dealer said.

At around 0820 GMT the local dollar was trading at 11.6280/6380 against the U.S. unit compared to 11.6300/6400 at Tuesday's close and was also firmer against sterling at 18.6510/6800 from 18.9300/9500, tracking a stronger U.S. dollar on the British currency overseas.
It was at 6.1665/1685 from 6.2000/2100 on the mark and at 2.4920/4985 against the rand from 2.5000/5100.
